osmoments: Exact Moments of Order Statistics

Source: R/osmoments-package.R
osmoments-package.Rd

Computes the exact means, variances and covariances of the order statistics \(X_{(1)} \le \dots \le X_{(n)}\) of an i.i.d. sample from a continuous distribution, at any ranks and any sample size, by numerical evaluation of the defining integrals, with closed forms where the distribution has them. Five families are built in (normal, uniform, exponential, logistic and Gumbel), and any other continuous distribution enters through its distribution, density and quantile functions via os_dist.

Details

The main function is os_moments, which returns the mean vector and the covariance matrix of the order statistics at the requested ranks. On top of it, os_quantile_weights, os_lin_moments and os_blue give the moments of sample quantiles and of any linear combination of order statistics, and Lloyd's best linear unbiased estimators of location and scale. The vignette walks through all of it: vignette("osmoments"). The paper of Wu and Tong (2026) describes the computation, its verification against closed forms, identities and printed tables, and the comparison with other software; citation("osmoments") gives the reference.

References

Wu, Z. and Tong, T. (2026). osmoments: Exact means, variances and covariances of order statistics in R. Manuscript.
